name: vault-terminal
title: Vault Terminal
description: A server-authoritative, patch-free addon panel that exposes a character's daily claim counter and rank.

acceptance.check: Open /vt and request the server snapshot.
acceptance.expected: Panel renders seals, target, available claims, and server-derived rank.

acceptance.check: Claim twice through separate sessions on the same server day.
acceptance.expected: At most one durable row for this character/day; later sequential claims receive COOLDOWN.

acceptance.check: Restart the worldserver and query the panel again.
acceptance.expected: Claim count and rank remain derived from the characters database.
Server answers BYE; addon stops polling and offers manual retry.

acceptance.check: Send malformed, oversized, wrong-version, and unknown-opcode frames.
acceptance.expected: Malformed/oversized and unknown frames do not mutate state; version mismatch is refused.

notes: This is an on-demand addon panel, not an NPC/world-spawn feature. It uses no custom item, spell, creature, client DBC, or MPQ. The characters table is retained on feature rollback to preserve user progress; operators disable the module/addon and may purge data only as a separate reviewed action after backup.
